body.label: Effect
body.html: Declare that one enemy within 5 units will not pass you. Until your next turn, gain +1 Defense against that enemy; if it willingly moves past you, it becomes Exposed.

surges.html: You may suffer -1 Defense until your next turn; if you do, one affected ally becomes Rallied.
One enemy affected by this card suffers -1 Defense against the ally you designate until its next turn.

rider.title: VOW — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an ally acts to uphold the Vow: 1–3 gain +1 Defense; 4–5 become Rallied; 6+ become Rallied and regain 1 Mana.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
